normalized_matching_profile.name: Watercolor "LakeHouse" 34 Viridian Park
normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Views of Western Lake- 4 Adult Bikes- Electric Vehicle Charger- 2,000+ Sq. Ft of Porch Space- Outdoor Shower - Outdoor bedroom- 3 Dedicated Parking Spots- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: Location, location! "Lake House" in Watercolor has the best views of Western Lake at complete privacy and is only three houses away from Seaside and five minutes away from the beach! This charming four-bedroom and four-bathroom home nestled in Watercolor's Cottage District sleeps 10 and was just remodeled with gorgeous, new decor on three levels. On the first floor, you will find the first two bedrooms. Each bedroom features a king bed with office space, access to the wraparound porch, a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, and a flat-screen TV. The screened-in porch features a hammock, queen bed, lounge seating for 8, and a ping pong table. The second floor opens up to the open living and kitchen space and has plenty of natural light coming in from the wrap-around porch overlooking Western Lake. The kitchen has sophisticated black and stainless steel appliances built into the cabinetry as well as a large, hooded stove range, kitchen island and seating for twelve at the dining table. There are two seating areas on the second floor, one featuring a flat-screen TV. Down the hall is a bunk room featuring one set of twin over twin bunk beds and one queen over twin, with a twin trundle bed, as well as a flat-screen TV. There is a common bathroom with a walk-in shower as well. Outside on the porch are beautiful, unobstructed views of Western Lake all the way around. There is a gas grill and outdoor dining areas, as well as lounge furniture to enjoy the view! Upstairs on the third floor is a large fourth bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom, with stunning lake views, plush white bedding, two office areas, and a mounted flat-screen TV. The ensuite bathroom features a double vanity and walk-in shower. Outside there is a fire pit, outdoor shower, and covered parking to fit three cars. You're only a short walk from the lake dock and a bike ride to the beach. This home truly has the best of both worlds, with the essence of coastal lake home and the bonus amenity of staying near award-winning beaches! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: Twin Bunk Bed, Twin over Queen Bunk Bed, and Twin Trundle, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*We are happy to welcome up to 2 dogs, not to exceed the weight limit of 50lbs for an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax. *Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 60 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
